object: a small agent on a builder canvas: four steps that light up when you press Run, each opening the case behind it
desc: A short path through Allen Kang's work: a no-code workflow builder, prototypes in code, a design system, and things that already run.
lede: I’m Allen, a product designer in Toronto, open to moving to Vancouver. Eight years designing, the last five on CRM and workflow tools, including a no-code automation builder built from zero. I prototype in code with Claude and Cursor when a mock can’t answer the question.
caption: Press Run. Every step opens the case behind it.
h1: I design for experts whose job isn’t software.
contact: I’d like to help more teams hand their busywork to agents they built themselves.
